headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Technical and striking. Tight tracking for massive scale.

body.strategy: Geometric and highly legible for data, dashboards, and catalogs.

colors.strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) meets Modern Developer Tools (Vercel/Linear tier). Dominant structural grayscale with precise, high-visibility orange accent. No muddy gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeletons for feature sections and product catalogs. Use border-collapse styled layouts with 1px solid subtle borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky headers (z-50) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and high opacity background (bg-black/80 dark, bg-white/80 light) with 1px bottom border. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary button uses solid orange with slight inner glow/shadow. Subtle scale down on active.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp edges for all cards and widgets. No soft, large, diffuse box-shadows. Use strict geometric borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (pointer-events-none) across the entire application to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.logo_motif: The 'T' mosaic logo (7 squares) should be integrated subtly into loading states or background patterns as a brand identifier.

components.strategy: Hybrid architecture. Marketing sections use raw HTML/Tailwind for artistic asymmetry. Product catalogs and Dashboards use Shadcn UI with severe customizations to match the high-contrast technical aesthetic.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism header with global navigation (Products, Apps, Agents, Tools, Software, Games, Company, Docs). Always include theme switcher and login/account CTA.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border. Hover state: border color intensifies (e.g., border-primary/50), subtle translation (-translate-y-1).
components.forms: Strictly Shadcn components (Input, Select, Checkbox). High contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
components.tables_data: Dense padding (p-2 to p-4). Monospace numerals for tabular data.
components.coming_soon: Sleek, minimalistic email capture with floating placeholder and immediate success state.
components.alerts_toasts: Use Sonner. Dark, high-contrast, technical looking toasts.
components.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24) for marketing sections. Tight Density (gap-4) for admin dashboard and product catalog.
grids_layouts.marketing: Asymmetric Bento Grids (Mode A). Break the standard 2-column layout. Use overlapping elements.
grids_layouts.dashboard_catalog: High Density Grid (Mode B) for /products, /apps, /agents. Every pixel utilized, structured, and easily scannable.
grids_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first responsive grids. Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

motion.strategy: Restrained, purposeful motion. Avoid slow fade-ins.
motion.interactions: Hover states must have immediate but smooth transitions (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.entrance: Staggered micro-animations for product catalog lists (opacity and slight Y-translation).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero sections and large image assets.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA and WCAG 2.2 AA. Normal text 4.5:1, Large text 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Clear, high-contrast focus rings for all interactive elements.

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react for UI interactions. phosphor-icons for marketing adornments.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract black and white dots, useful for technical/data background
Dark hallway with blue/white lights, great for 'future technology' thematic sections

product_mockups.description: Clean bar chart UI on screen, good for 'SaaS' or 'Tools' category image

company_vision.description: Modern data center, conveys scale and infrastructure capability
Server rack, implies serious tech foundation

3d_and_creative_libraries.recommendation: TSParticles for subtle hero background node/constellation effect to imply 'AI Agents' connecting. Framer Motion for bento grid animations.
3d_and_creative_libraries.rule: Avoid heavy WebGL unless specifically rendering a product. Prioritize speed and clarity.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'. Left align text for readability.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients. Use solid colors and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating elements (navs, dropdowns, toasts).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖 or 💡. Use actual SVG icons.
Ensure all code uses standard JavaScript (JSX) as the project uses .js/.jsx, not TypeScript.
Never use placeholder image services (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Always provide a full navigation bar with all requested routes, and ensure routing is implemented correctly for the catalog platform.
